(B) grades_left_out matches the declared entry read off a joined name by _evidence_io.step_parts as well as the whole name. outcome.descriptive: One liveness reading now decides a dead base run's sweep. A joined step that grades a left-out path is read back with that reason, as is a single-step one on a quiet host. A repeated gate's timing names the run whose stage it records.
